purpose: base spec for concurrent pinned mini-swe-agent sessions with read-only snapshot observations, Qwen3-1.7B at temperature 0.7, sharing one vLLM CPU cache; live_concurrent.py derives each session's proxy port and label

environment.observation: read-only commands answered from the baseline tree (experiments/agent-task/readonly_env.py); other commands get a fixed not-available reply
environment.template_vars_note: stated task-container values for the instance template's uname fields; not read from the capture host

sampling_note: no seed is sent; sessions diverge after the shared system and task prompt, and runs are reproducible only from their captures
